newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian bullion ends up on global trends.
newsitem.headline: Indian bullion ends up on global trends.

text.p: Silver (.999) closed 70 rupees higher at 7,480 rupees per kg up against the previous close of 7,410 rupees on the back of thin arrivals and rising global prices.
** Gold 24 carat closed 25 rupees higher at 4,850 rupees per 10 gramme up against previous closing of 4,825 rupees on fresh seasonal buying and an upsurge in the world market.

** Prices of a gold biscuit (116.50 gramme) closed 300 rupees higher at 56,700 rupees per piece up against previous closing of 56,400 rupees per piece. They were up by 300 rupees on Thursday. Prices gained 600 rupees per piece in the two trading days.
